deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To integrate Claude API with Baukjen's Shopify store, follow these steps: 1) Sign up for a Claude API account and obtain an API key. 2) In Shopify, navigate to the 'Apps' section and click 'Manage apps'. 3) Click 'Add app' and select 'Claude API' from the list of available apps. 4) Enter your API key and configure the app settings as desired. 5) Test the integration by generating a product description using the Claude API and verifying that it appears correctly on your Shopify product page.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.
